scenario: first physical sliding-window send renders HELLO then stalls the software queue

tags.drawing: HELLO text followed by queued long text and dot

notes: The real DS visibly rendered HELLO. The capture contains fifteen drawing-reply diagnostic markers although firmware completed enough of the transfer for the host to render it. Rust paired individual captured poll and acknowledgement frames, remained one reply behind, timed out message 0, and left before the queued long text and dot could start. This capture motivated cumulative firmware cursor telemetry so a later host command can recover any missed monitor frames.

evidence.physical_result: HELLO rendered on the real DS
evidence.software_result: delivery timeout; later queued messages were not armed
